baseName.value: Group IV Windows and Balcony Doors wooden with 20 kg wood frame

generalComment.value: IV Group window / balcony door wooden and wooden with aluminium cladding is tripleglazed and has a thermal transmittance of 1,1 W/(m2*K). The dimensions (height x width) are made according to the customer's requirements. The calculation is based on the assumption that LCA results are scalable for the desired window dimension. The product is manufactured in Ventspils, Latvia, and marketed internationally. Kiwa-Ecobility Experts shall not be liable with respect to manufacturer information, life cycle assessment data and evidence.

shortDescription.value: Project report windows and doors from SIA ARBO Windows

description.value: All installed raw materials of the product were analysed, and the masses were determined following the allocation and cut-off requirements. Production-specific energy consumption were measured and provided by SIA ARBO Windows. Since the production process is quite similar for all of the products produced at the manufacturing site, the energy consumption, ancillary materials and production waste is allocated according to the annual production of the standard sized elements and then declared per square meter of the product. The total annual production data is recorded to a high standard of accuracy and precision. The production waste of wood, paint and other mixed production waste is collected separately. Wood waste is thermally recovered at the site. As the product is marketed internationally, no country-specific waste scenario can be considered. Therefore, the waste scenario of PCR B (EN 17213 Appendix B.3) was adopted. Removing the window does not result in any emissions to air or soil, so the value for module C1 is assumed to be zero.

descriptionOfRestrictions.value: The geographical reference area is Europe or Global and can be seen in the system description boundary table.

technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse.value: This EPD covers the IV Group wood and wood aluminium clad windows and balcony doors. The windows and doors are inward-opening customized building components with different mode of action (e.g. tilt, fixed, tilt ad turn). The dimensions (height x width) are adapted according to customer's requirements. The results are an average of the whole group. IV Group windows and balcony doors includes the following products: IV 78 Window – Wood; IV 78 Window – Wood with aluminium cladding; IV 92 Window – Wood; IV 92 Window – Wood with aluminium cladding; IV 68 Window – Wood; IV 68 Window – Wood with aluminium cladding; IV 92 EI30 Fire-resistant window (fixed and tilt and turn); FT/EI 92.48 Fire-resistant window; IV 78 Door – Wood; IV 78 Door– Wood with aluminium cladding; IV 92 Door – Wood; IV 92 Door – Wood with aluminium cladding; IV 68 Door – Wood; IV 68 Door – Wood with aluminium cladding. The products included in the IV Group are very similar products and go through the same production steps. A wooden frame is identified to be the single highest contributor to the differences within the declared group of products. The products with the wooden frame of 20 kg are IV 68 Windows and IV 68 Doors. The products with the wooden frame of 25 kg are IV 78 Windows and IV 78 Doors. And the products with the wooden frame of 30 kg are as follows: IV 92 Windows, IV 92 EI30 Fire-resistant windows, FT/EI 92.48 Fire resistant windows and IV 92 Doors. The biggest total result difference between the products without aluminium cladding in mandatory LCIA categories are as follows: Eutrophication, marine (EP-fw, kg N eqv.) and Photochemical ozone formation - human health (POCP, kg NMVOC eqv.) are 7% lower for windows/ balcony doors with wooden frame of 20 kg than with wooden frame of 30 kg. Global warming potential (GWP-total, kg CO2 eqv.) is 3% lower for windows/ balcony doors with wooden frame of 20 kg. The biggest total result difference between the products with aluminium cladding in mandatory LCIA categories are as follows: Eutrophication, marine (EP-fw, kg N eqv.) and Photochemical ozone formation - human health (POCP, kg NMVOC eqv.) are 5% lower for windows/ balcony doors with wooden frame of 20 kg than with wooden frame of 30 kg. Global warming potential (GWP-total, kg CO2 eqv.) is 2% lower for windows/ balcony doors with wooden frame of 20 kg. Overall, the difference is within +/-10%, for the total of modules A1-C4 across any of the core impact indicators. Given that the results are presented in two result tables for 1 m2 of a window, i.e. the results of a product with the lowest amount of wood frame of 20 kg and the highest amount of wood frame of 30 kg, respectively. In addition, LCA results of the IV Group windows and balcony doors are declared separately for wooden windows/ balcony doors and wooden windows/ balcony doors with aluminium cladding. The manufacturing contains the following processes: Extraction and delivery of raw materials; Cutting and profiling; Impregnation; Assembly of frame; Priming and painting of frame; Assembly of complete product; Packing and delivery.
